deployments_detail.use: MoAI (Mobis one AI) generative-AI service (launched Oct 2025); connects to internal systems for doc/image search, analysis reports; used in R&D, quality, sales, production, IT

Acoustic AI quality inspection at the Changwon plant: an AI system analyzes subtle sounds/waveforms generated during production of Electric Power Steering (EPS/MDPS) units to detect defects, inspecting at one unit per second across ~1.3 million units/year (23-stage process). [in-house (Hyundai Mobis)]
deployments_detail.value: one unit inspected per second; ~1.3 million EPS units/year at Changwon

deployments_detail.use: Natural-language AI extension of the acoustic quality-inspection system: analyzes rotational sounds of motor-driven power steering components not only to detect defects but to identify and describe their root causes, being piloted at the Changwon plant. [in-house (Hyundai Mobis)]

Generative AI model that recreates/simulates virtual driving environments by integrating text and image data to generate diverse road conditions for autonomous-driving development; research paper recognized as an outstanding paper at CVPR 2025. [in-house (Hyundai Mobis)]

In-Cabin Monitoring System (ICM): cameras plus analytic software logic detect passenger posture, position and bio-signals in real time to identify and alert on 10+ unsafe behaviors (drowsy driving, phone use, smoking, hands-off-wheel, unbuckled seatbelts, unattended children); ASPICE-certified, entering global order-taking. [in-house (Hyundai Mobis)]

M.Brain: brainwave-based driver monitoring system using earset sensors that analyze the driver's brain waves in real time to detect drowsiness/inattention and issue alerts; validated in on-road trials. [in-house (Hyundai Mobis)]
deployments_detail.value: reduced drowsiness and inattentive driving by up to 13%

deployments_detail.use: World-first predictive Adaptive Driving Beam (ADB) headlamp technology using a 12-segment silicon-optic matrix for real-time beam adaptation that selectively dims segments around oncoming/preceding vehicles based on sensor and ADAS input. [in-house (Hyundai Mobis)]

ADAS sensor suite (forward-looking cameras, radar, LiDAR) used to identify potential threats around the vehicle, alert the driver, and activate driver-assistance/autonomous-driving functions; supplied as production Hyundai Mobis products. [in-house (Hyundai Mobis)]

Data-driven validation platform for software-defined vehicles (SDV) and ADAS that links real road-test data with data-management solutions and simulators to replicate driving scenarios and validate autonomous-driving sensor algorithms (radar, camera, LiDAR, ultrasonic); planned expansion to 60 linked simulators. [in-house (Hyundai Mobis)]
deployments_detail.value: 10,000 hours of validation in one week once expanded to 60 simulators
